_about: Coloured bands on grenade-launcher rounds (Tefa 2026-11-25): one worn, flush paint band in the groove at the base of every live and spent round. tools/blender/build_gm79_spent_shell.py and tools/mdf_build_gm79_shells.py read this file when they build the game files; the Lua reads 're8.ammo' at run time to pick the band. base_color multiplies the game's own metal texture under the band (Weapon_Default.mmtr BaseColor), so it is brighter than the paint looks [hypothesis: tune in the headset].

re8._about: Village's GM 79 has two rounds (Tefa 2026-11-25). Bullet item ids as the plugin logs them ('ammo: bullet item id ...'); an id not listed here gets the explosive band. 1927571624 was the id in the b170 robot run [inferred: that run is believed to have had explosive rounds]; the flash id is not known yet: read it from the log with flash rounds loaded.
